title: Learn a Novel Procedure
claimTested: Spoon can retain a procedure definition and derive answers for novel inputs instead of memorizing examples.

phases.purpose: Provide a reusable procedure definition once.

input.prompt: A florp operation means multiply a number by three and add one.

criteria: records or acknowledges a reusable florp procedure

phases.purpose: Invoke the learned procedure on a new input without Teacher assistance.
Use a negative input to test procedure generality.

criteria: applies the procedure to a novel negative input
